---
title: "Interactive Data Visualizations"

These interactive figures were developed in R to communicate the
structure, evidence relationships, and model-facing characteristics of
the ethnographic fire-use dataset.

## Evidence traceability circle pack

This visualization communicates relationships among evidence records,
comparative fire classes, and canonical fire uses.

[Explore the circle pack](viz-circlepack.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## Comparative class and ontology heatmap

This heatmap compares comparative fire classes across selected ontology
and model-facing variables.

[Explore the ontology heatmap](viz-ontology-heatmap.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## Spatial-form treemap

This treemap communicates how spatial forms are represented across the
structured fire-use categories.

[Explore the spatial-form treemap](viz-spatial-treemap.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## Timing and spatial-form heatmap

This heatmap explores relationships between documented timing regimes
and spatial forms.

[Explore the timing heatmap](viz-timing-spatial.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
